latest_release.name: Tinycast 0.17.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Keep a note closed when you close it with text selected by @notkainoa in #1913
* fix(calendar): stop re-checking access every minute without a grant by @hannoeru in #1922
* Remove the bundle id migration and the old pasteboard fallback by @abue-ammar in #1931
* Check for updates twice a day; add it to the app menu and About by @abue-ammar in #1918
* Calculator: constants, molar mass, text functions, bracketed phrases and a faster engine by @list-jonas in #1928
* Fix Toggle Hidden Files failing on macOS 27 when the key is unset by @abue-ammar in #1932
* Calculator: convert to and from sats by @abue-ammar in #1933
* Icon pack: SF Symbols tiles for Settings, commands and system actions by @abue-ammar in #1938
* File Search: match through folders, and an Include hidden files setting by @abue-ammar in #1939
* iCloud Sync: settings and content across Macs by @abue-ammar in #1940
* Remove Dictation key (🎤) shortcuts: the key goes back to macOS Dictation by @abue-ammar in #1947
* Unregister hotkeys of disabled features by @dguaraglia in #1944
* Stop two errors the app logs on its own by @abue-ammar in #1950
* Make the snippet argument prompt keyboard-driven by @abue-ammar in #1951
* Keep forwarded Hyper chords from toggling Caps Lock by @webpro in #1961
* Run Settings in its own process by @abue-ammar in #1966
* Bug fixes and UI enhancements by @abue-ammar in #1971
* Update the Raycast export passphrase path for Raycast 2.0 by @ertembiyik in #1973
* Let icon tiles follow the system icon style by @abue-ammar in #1975
* Stack the thirds on portrait displays by @abue-ammar in #1976
* Name the missing translation language and weigh the reader's languages by @abue-ammar in #1977
* Sync clipboard history with iCloud by @abue-ammar in #1978
* Close the palette when ⌘, opens Settings by @abue-ammar in #1979
* Add room shortcuts and a room HUD by @abue-ammar in #1985
* Share the pill HUD and drop Add Window to Current Room by @abue-ammar in #1987
* Find files by pasted or partial paths by @abue-ammar in #1988
* Show AI plan usage in the menu bar by @abue-ammar in #1989
* Confirm quicklink, snippet and custom command saves with a HUD by @abue-ammar in #1993
* Redesign first-run onboarding by @Risengan in #1996
* Open the DMG as a styled install window by @abue-ammar in #1997
* Focus the default dialog button under Keyboard navigation by @abue-ammar in #1998

## New Contributors
* @notkainoa made their first contribution in #1913
* @hannoeru made their first contribution in #1922
* @dguaraglia made their first contribution in #1944
* @ertembiyik made their first contribution in #1973

**Channel:** stable · **Version:** 0.17.0 · **Bundle ID:** `com.abueammar.tinycast`
Built from c2690533874e22df6bef89e8288b2e4e246bc258. [Full changelog](https://github.com/abue-ammar/tinycast/compare/v0.12.15...v0.17.0)

detail.readme:
Tinycast

A native macOS launcher built for productivity. Fast, lightweight, and open source.

Website · Install · Docs · Support


Built with SwiftUI and AppKit. No dependencies, no Electron, no telemetry. It runs your Raycast extensions, too. [Explore all features →](https://tinycast.dev/#features) For anything private, feel free to email [hello@tinycast.dev](mailto:hello@tinycast.dev). ## Install On an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 26 or newer: ```sh brew install --cask tinycast brew install --cask tinycast@beta ``` - **DMG:** notarized, download from [Releases](https://github.com/abue-ammar/tinycast/releases). Drag `Tinycast.app` to `/Applications`. - **Intel Mac:** install from [Homebrew tap](https://github.com/abue-ammar/homebrew-tinycast). ## Support Tinycast is free and stays free. If it earns a place on your Mac, consider supporting its development. Thank you!
